name: RC-B10-0201/2026 – After § 5 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
part_text: 5c. Calls on the Commission and the Council to present a new architecture for European collective security, to be based on the principles of the UN Charter and the Helsinki Final Act, in order to guarantee peace and security for all on the European continent;
